items.title: Johnson Controls International (JCI) Names New Chief Legal Officer And CIO
items.summary: Johnson Controls International (NYSE:JCI) appointed Katie Rowen as Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, effective immediately. Shauna Latshaw has been named Chief Information Officer for Johnson Controls International with responsibility for global technology and AI priorities. Rowen will oversee legal, governance and sustainability matters, while Latshaw will lead enterprise AI and cybersecurity programs across the group. items.title: JCI Q3 deep dive: data center demand, margin expansion, and portfolio simplification
items.summary: Building operations company Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with sales up 10.4% year on year to $7.11 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.66 per share was 4.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
